projects.name: mcpsum
projects.tagline: Stop MCP servers from rug-pulling your AI agent.
projects.description: A lockfile and runtime reference monitor for MCP tools, like go.sum for the tools your agent trusts. Definitions are served from the mcp.lock you reviewed, so text a server swaps in after approval never reaches the model.

projects.name: MergeCode
projects.tagline: This patch passes tests. Would a maintainer merge it?
projects.description: Judges AI-generated patches the way a reviewer does: runs your checks, catches the tricks that get code to green (deleted asserts, skipped tests, new deps, CI edits) and returns a verdict with evidence.

projects.name: VibeForge
projects.tagline: Describe the moment. Get a playlist that fits it.
projects.description: An agentic playlist generator: a mood analyst, a curator and a critic work through a LangGraph state machine to turn plain language into ten well-balanced tracks. Accepted into the 500-AI-Agents-Projects repository.

projects.name: Graph RAG
projects.tagline: Answers from your documents and the connections between them.
projects.description: Qdrant vector search plus Neo4j graph facts, cited and streamed over FastAPI SSE. Runs fully local on Ollama or on Hugging Face, with a golden-set eval harness and Langfuse tracing.
